Class ConsoleUI

java.lang.Object
ui.ConsoleUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UI
public class ConsoleUI extends Object implements UI
Runs a text menu on standard input and output, delegating operations to services. The scanner is created with the instance and is not closed by this class.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Runs the interface's interaction lifecycle until its implementation finishes. Displays the menu repeatedly until command zero or end-of-input at the command prompt, then prints a farewell. Number-format, argument, repository, unsupported-operation and validation errors inside the loop are printed and interaction continues. Unknown commands print a message. Other unchecked errors propagate; end-of-input while entering operation fields is not caught.
      Specified by:
      start in interface UI
      Throws:
      NoSuchElementException - if input ends while an operation reads a field
      IllegalStateException - if the scanner has been closed
      NullPointerException - if a selected operation requires a null service
